reviews.text: Craig and his team were professional, responsive, and thorough in repairing roof damage from recent windstorms. The quality of their work was excellent. I’ve already recommended Competitive Roofing & Construction and will gladly continue to do so.
reviews.author: Roy Wood

reviews.text:
5 Stars – Highly Recommend!

Craig and his team at Competitive Roofing & Construction are outstanding! He is incredibly trustworthy, reliable, and offers very reasonable pricing. After the recent storm ripped several shingles off our roof, Craig responded quickly—knowing rain was on the way—and was able to fix everything on short notice to prevent any potential leaks.

What really stood out was how thorough and patient he was throughout the entire process. He walked us through the details, took the time to explain everything clearly, and even worked directly with our insurance adjuster to make sure everything was handled smoothly.

I strongly recommend Craig and his company for any roofing needs. You’ll be in good hands!
reviews.author: Ray Gun

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Competitive Roofing when I asked them to inspect and repair a leak around my water heater exhaust. Craig's crew quickly identified the issue and were able to repair it the same day at a fair price. They even matched the shingles so well that I can barely tell any work was done! I’ll definitely be recommending them to friends and family for any future roofing needs.
reviews.author: Thomas Morgan

reviews.text: Thanks guys from Competitive Roofing for taking good care of our replacement pergola. They suggested improvements to make it last longer in the future. Also painted the deck
reviews.author: Chad Pursley

reviews.text: Craig has been to my house three times. The first time was with a different company but the last two times was with his company that that he runs now. I needed a new roof wind turbine installed and he provided me a reasonable quote. I knew other companies can’t beat his rate so I didn’t bother getting quotes from other companies. He and his employee came out and got it installed in a little over an hour. From the street, it looked perfect aligned and was spinning. He won’t upsale you or sell you anything that isn’t needed. If you want an honest company that does good work and won’t rip you off, call Competitive Roofing. No. I get no compensation from writing this review.
reviews.author: H Ton

reviews.text: Craig & team were responsive, professional and thorough with their work to replace several (more than I knew about) roofing tiles that we lost during the recent windstorms.  I've already recommended Competitive Roofing & Construction to friends and will continue to do so.  This is a great, local company!
reviews.author: Andrew Chambers

reviews.text: Craig and his team came out to do a same day roof inspection after a huge storm. Turns out there was some damage but thankfully it was minimal.  It was repaired quickly and at a reasonable price. I appreciate Craig’s honesty and transparency, which you don’t see often. Communication was great! I would definitely consider CRC again in the future!  Thanks again!
reviews.author: Richard Quach

reviews.text: Craig was real friendly and helpful, did a wonderful job, and had very reasonable prices. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Andrew Sikes

reviews.text:
After a recent hail storm we were worried about damage to our roof.  We had a number of “storm chasers” knock on our door but avoided all of them.
When I contacted Craig about an inspection and possibly replacing our roof, he was very quick to respond.  He called me to discuss my concerns in detail and quickly arranged for someone to come look at our roof.  His team member arrived and introduced himself and I’m glad he did or we never would have known he was here.  He was so quiet we didn’t hear him on the roof.  Craig called within minutes to explain that our roof did not need to be replaced and was in good shape.  He even explained the type of shingles we have.
We great appreciated Craig’s honesty and the time he took to explain how to go about a replacement in the future if necessary.  I have already recommended Craig and his team to my family in the area and would recommend them to anyone else in need of a roofer.
reviews.author: Deanna Webb

reviews.text:
Craig and his team are fantastic!
We were on a time crunch and worried about getting our roof done before the house closed.
Craig was openly communicating with me as we went through the process of trying to get our insurance claim.
He got us on the schedule very quickly and they were able to knock everything out before we closed.
He is extremely professional and very great to work with!
I would highly recommend him to anyone who is needing any work done!
reviews.author: Jenni Kiggins

reviews.text: So happy I found CRC and Craig. He was able to get someone out same day to check the damage and give a quote, and on top of that was able to repair it for under the other quotes I was given (I had other people saying we should go through insurance and replace the entire roof). They were out early the next morning and finished the repair in about an hour. Craig and his team were professional and glad to provide more information when I had questions about things the other roofers had said. 11 out of 10. Will keep them on speed dial for any other issues. Thanks Craig!
reviews.author: Carter Bailey

reviews.text: We had a leak by a chimney that caused damage to our drywall and mantle. Craig’s crew were very professional. I received pictures before the work, and also the steps of the work completed. They went above and beyond to ensure my leak was fixed. I have not had a roofer before that was as thorough. I highly recommend Competitive Roofing and Construction!
reviews.author: Mary Head

reviews.text: Craig was prompt and competed the job in a timely manner! Great service! Thank you
reviews.author: Josh and Karen Coe

reviews.text: Outstanding service and product!  Craig is very professional and takes pride in his work.  We recommend Competitive Roofing & Construction to anyone needing work on their roof.  They also did our guttering!
reviews.author: Jackie Townsend

reviews.text: Hands down, the best roofing company I have used to date.  They were fast, worked with my insurance and made them pay way more than they offered at first to make sure the job was done right.  I have replaced my roof a few times over the years and this was the best company I have ever used. Always on time and made sure all work was completed fully.  I will always recommend them to everyone from now on!
reviews.author: Brendan Haller

reviews.text: My wife and I needed someone to replace our roof due to hail damage. With so many roofing companies out there, you want to find the right person for the job. Thankfully we were referred to Competitive Roofing by our neighbor and we couldn't be happier with our choice. Always available when needed, job was completed the right way and very friendly. My wife and I both are 100% satisfied.
reviews.author: Clint Connally

reviews.text: Craig responded quickly to my phone message. He addressed the issues we had same day and did great work!!
reviews.author: Brian Nelson

reviews.text: Craig helped us with repairs on our roof. He was quick and fair priced. we will be using him again if we need for any roofing needs.
reviews.author: chloe B
